context_policy.rule: Every scheduler must begin from the complete repository state for its checked-out revision, read the live champion and V6 model architecture manifests, and may specialize only after the project-wide context snapshot is available. Research that reintroduces live expert averaging, semantic-price averaging or heterogeneous global PCA is non-promotable.

grafana.rule: The canonical URL and dashboard UID remain stable while the dashboard data source follows the manifest-selected paper champion.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
